step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows a user interacting via a Web Browser with a Web Server / Job Manager running on an EC2 instance. The Job Manager uses Lambda to pull metadata from an S3 bucket storing input video clips, and persists metadata into a Database (RDS). Video processing jobs are then executed on GPU-enabled G3 EC2 instances (Asset Manager / G3 processing) that read/write from/to S3. An optional IMF EC2 instance is drawn for IMF wrapping.

graph.name: Cinefilm PixelStrings Video Processing Architecture
graph.notes: Video processing platform running on AWS using GPU EC2 instances, S3, Lambda, and RDS.

edges.notes: User logs into PixelStrings web app
Job Manager triggers Lambda to fetch metadata
Lambda reads clip metadata from S3 bucket
Job Manager saves and queries metadata from Database
Asset Manager copies input/output clips between local disk and S3
